text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year. As the new year began, 
Tamamo Cross moved up to the Classic 
Class.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Trainer! Lookin' forward 
to workin' with ya again this year.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's pretty lonely, huh. Spendin' 
New Year's so far away, all alone without 
your family..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I can't go home yet. There's no way I can 
go back... I haven't grabbed hold of what 
I need to take back with me yet.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This year and next year are where it 
counts! I'm counting on ya, Trainer.

Renewing our vow. Our challenge in the 
Twinkle Series reaches its climax starting 
this year.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even if I can't go home, there's no 
helping it, but at least I won't feel 
settled until I hear Ma's voice. Maybe 
I'll call her later...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I might not be your okaachan~, but your 
mama is right here~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wha--!? Creek, you came too?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, giving New Year's greetings. I look 
forward to working with you this year too, 
Tama-chan, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Because this year is an important year for 
me as well.
choice_data_list: Why is it such an important year?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm also planning to move on to the 
Twinkle Series around autumn this year, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I won't be able to run alongside 
Tama-chan, but I'll do my best, step by 
step.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really?! Creek's planning to make her 
debut too? Well, that's mighty fine news 
to hear right at the start of the new 
year!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... didn't 'that guy' 
say they were thinking of debuting this 
year too? Haha, things are gonna get super 
lively!"

A steady stream of new Umamusume are 
debuting from the younger ranks. It feels 
like a lot of changes are in store around 
here this year.
choice_data_list:
So, you two—what are your resolutions for 
this year?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Umm~, my resolution for this year is...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll go with "I want to pamper 
Tama-chan."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*Faceplants*! Who sets a wishy-washy 
resolution like that!? At least make it 
'first win' or somethin'!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm, let's go with that, then.
choice_data_list:
What's your New Year's resolution, Tamamo 
Cross?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Mine's already decided, ain't it?! 'Bring 
home huge happiness for my family!' That's 
it right there!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Umm... But that's what Tama-chan's been 
saying this whole time, right? All through 
last year, too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, ya got me there... Well, guess that 
ain't really a New Year's resolution.
choice_data_list:
On the other hand, wouldn't something a 
little more relaxed be fine too?

text_block_list.text:
Pushing oneself too hard all the time 
leads to burnout. When I suggest setting a 
slightly more relaxed resolution...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, maybe you're right, Trainer. It's 
New Year's, after all—having some fun is 
important too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, keeping it super casual, if I had to 
say what I wanna try this year...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Then I'll polish up my tsukkomi 
comebacks! A sharp wit is essential, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No matter who clowns around or where, I'll 
hit 'em with a straight-man routine 
without mercy! Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Phew... When it comes to things you can 
only do on New Year's... it's definitely 
running alone, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"The heck?! You're always running by 
yourself anyway!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see, "Happy New Year." A fitting phrase 
for the season, but looking a bit deeper 
into it...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Today is the New Year! I see. Hehehe, 
hehehehehe...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What're ya gettin' hooked on right at the 
start of the year! Are you tryin' to be 
cute?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch, a blank fortune. Bad omen. An amateur 
would call it quits here. But—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
On the next draw—I'll pull the winning 
tile!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Are you stupid?! You can't just redraw!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Trainer, doing this 
with Tracen Academy girls is seriously 
exhausting, y'know...

Right from the start of the year, 
straight-man retorts were needed left and 
right. It turned out to be quite a good 
workout.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's it! In that case, why don't we all 
have a takoyaki party?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I've got the plate, so don't worry. Let's 
meet up in the Trainer's room later, 
yeah?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, perfect timing. It's cooked now, 
so go ahead and dig in.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um, Tama-chan? There isn't any octopus in 
this takoyaki. Is that alright~?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, octopus, yeah. Sure, it's great if we 
have it, but today I figured I'd feed ya 
somethin' a bit more interestin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, trust me and take a bite! It's my 
special 'Octopus-less Takoyaki'! The broth 
is delicious!

When we tried it... the broth was truly 
exquisite, and it was so fluffy and 
delicious. And so, the three of us relaxed 
together over New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's it! In that case, how about doin' 
some sightseein' in Tokyo?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't usually get to look around at my 
own leisurely pace, ya know. Come on, keep 
me company.

And so, the place I arrived at with Tamamo 
Cross and the others was, surprisingly, an 
art museum.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Phew, lookin' at art every once in a while 
is pretty nice. I actually kinda like 
paintin's, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Heh~, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know an old guy who deals in 
antique art.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I used to be shown 'em a lot when I was 
little. Tokyo's got heaps of great 
paintings too, eh? Like Uman Gogh and 
Umacroix...

Seeing an unexpected side of her and 
admiring so many fine paintings seemed to 
have enriched her imagination.
